Flow.description:
Products in this calculation: Cross Border Payments - FWXB1000
Migrated from the [Opp Product] Travel Calculator with Utilization process using multiple criteria. New Travel Calculator with Region, Industry and Utilization. Request in SAL-2006. SAL-3872 updated 04/04/2024. SAL-3822 updated 04/24/2024. Added ByPass to skip validation rules on Opportunity 05/14/2024. Update to make currency conversion and filter by product code; renewals should not generate ARR; use Ship_To_Account__r 07/24/2024. Use Quote_Line_Type__c instead of Opportunity.Type 07/26/2024. Utilization percentages EMEA Accommodation and APAC Travel modified SAL-4325. BOPI-511 Updated to calculate ARR when Quote Line Type not 'Cancellation' or 'Renewal'. BOPI-518 removing Opp criteria filters to let the flow run when renewals are created and the quote line fields are empty. BOPI-603 updated to set ARR to 0 for cancelled lines. BOPI-620 updated to set the ARR for cancelled lines to the original amount as a negative value
